entities.name: Myczil Zunich
entities.description: A wojek officer with an extraordinary record, partner of Agrus Kos, who died after killing a girl by mistake.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Zunich's partner whose sense of justice overrode his friendship.

entities.name: Fonn Zunich
entities.description: Myczil's daughter, bitter toward Kos until he told her the truth.

entities.name: Palla
entities.description: Rakdos gang leader Kos and Zunich were tasked with arresting.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: Devkarin huntmaster and bounty hunter who set the trap and witnessed Zunich's act.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Tried with Savra to take over the Selesnya guild.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: Tried with Szadek to take over the Selesnya guild.

entities.name: Myczil Savod Zunich
entities.description: Fonn's son, named after her father.

entities.name: Wojek
entities.description: Ravnican law enforcement for which Zunich and Kos worked.

entities.name: Selesnya
entities.description: Guild targeted by Szadek and Savra.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: Event during which the takeover attempt was prevented.

events.summary: Kos and Zunich are tasked with arresting Rakdos gang leader Palla in 9943 Z.C.
events.quote: Kos and Zunich were tasked with finding and arresting Palla

events.summary: Zunich mistakenly attacks and kills a little girl who was bait in Jarad's trap for Palla.
events.quote: he mistakenly attacked and killed a little girl

events.summary: Mad with guilt, Zunich tries to kill Jarad as the sole witness; Kos tries to stop him and Zunich slips off the roof and dies.
events.quote: Zunich slipped and fell off the roof and was killed by the impact.

events.summary: After thwarting Szadek and Savra's Selesnya takeover, Kos tells Fonn the truth about her father's death.

relations.quote: together they had a daughter, Fonn Zunich

relations.note: Tried to kill him as the sole witness
relations.quote: then tried to kill Jarad as the sole witness of his act
Fonn later named her son, Myczil Savod Zunich , after her father.
